title: Bolted flange
sentence: A circular flange with a central bore and a six-bolt hole pattern, seated under a uniform preload pressure.

expected.reference: no closed form; a stair-stepped lattice puts only two or three elements across a 12 mm bolt hole, so read this as a load path, not a stress

theory: The lattice mesher stair-steps a CSG solid, so the Body's own face Sets do not survive onto the mesh. `geometry.nameFace` with a plane predicate names the flat seat and crown from the mesh itself, which is the general way to put a boundary condition on a body no structured mesher fits.
